maya: Spinning up ap-northeast-1 private cluster for research GPU workloads. Before we provision nodes we need security baseline sign-off for the cluster (IAM roles, secrets, KMS/HSM integration, network egress rules, and runtime privilege separation). Can infra + security validate? TL;DR checklist at the bottom.

chris: Ack. Do we need HSM-backed keys for this tenant or a regular Cloud KMS key will do?

maya: Prefer HSM for customer X due to compliance, but for internal research teams KMS-standard OK. We should document both flows.

alex: Quick cost note: HSM keys add per-op costs — if we do high-volume encryption for ephemeral secrets, that'll add up. We can mitigate with envelope encryption and a short-lived DEK cached on the instance.

leah: Copy. Two asks from sec: 1) IAM least-privilege roles + role binding review; 2) ensure no secrets in instance metadata or env vars.

maya: Draft checklist (please review):
- IAM: dedicated SA for node-provisioner, node-runtime, and metrics-collector. No wildcard permissions. Use role separation: `roles/compute.instanceAdmin` only for node-provisioner; `roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor` scoped to node-runtime SA.
- Secrets: use Secrets Manager + KMS envelope encryption. Mount secrets via sidecar (vault-agent or secretfs) not env.
- KMS/HSM: customer keys = HSM (CloudHSM) with key policy allowing only KMS decrypt from node-runtime SA. Internal keys = KMS w/ CMEK.
- Key rotation: auto-rotate every 90 days. Tag keys with `redwood:cluster=ap-nrt` for audit.
- Network: egress whitelist for model registry and telemetry endpoints, block all other outbound by default.
- Privilege separation: container runtime drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN, run GPU driver as dedicated privileged daemon with minimal surface area.
- Audit: enable CMEK/KMS audit logs, Secret Manager access logs, and GKE/VM metadata audit.
- IAM simulation: run `tools/iam_sim.py --cluster ap-nrt --sa node-runtime` before granting production roles.

chris: Nice. For the KMS policy, can you paste the minimal binding you want?

maya: Sure, minimal snippet:```json
{
  "bindings": [
    {
      "role": "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter",
      "members": [
        "serviceAccount:node-runtime@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

leah: Also add a policy check that denies `projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*/cryptoKeyVersions/*/destroy` unless requestor in `security-admins` group. Prevent accidental key destruction.

infra-bot: PR created: infra/terraform#3421 (kms: add ap-nrt keyring + IAM binding). See: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/3421 :pushpin:

alex: We should include a smoke test plan for the secrets flow. Example command to validate access: ```bash
# run on node runtime
curl -sS http://localhost:8200/v1/secret/data/model-creds | jq -r '.data.data'
# then attempt KMS decrypt via gcloud kms decrypt...
```

leah: Security checklist items for sign-off: 1) IAM simulation successful; 2) secrets sidecar tested on staging; 3) KMS key policy reviewed + HSM provision timeline confirmed; 4) egress rules enforced by Network Policy and VPC firewall; 5) audit logs hooked into SIEM.

ops-oncall: HSM provisioning heads-up — procurement and region availability: ap-northeast-1 HSM slots are limited, expect a 72-hour lead for key material import. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maya: Good to know — we can fall back to KMS for initial CI work, then migrate to HSM before go-live.

chris: One more: ensure node metadata endpoint is disabled or protected: set `metadata concealment` for GCE or `metadata work` for EC2. No app should read instance metadata for secrets.

leah: I'll run the IAM sim and review the TF PR today. If green, I'll add :white_check_mark: to the PR.

maya: Thanks team. I'll update the runbook with the exact CLI steps and the terraform variables to use for HSM vs KMS; will re-post when done. Marking this thread as the canonical checkpoint for ap-nrt security baseline. :lock: :eyes:

chris: Approved pending PR changes.

infra-bot: CI passed for infra/terraform#3421 (plan OK).

leah: IAM sim complete, no excessive permissions found. I added a deny rule for key destruction. PR ready for merge from my side. :white_check_mark:

maya: Merging infra PR after leah's final comment. Preparing node provisioning ticket with timeline and cost estimate. Thanks everyone.

ops-oncall: Noted — HSM lead time added to ticket (72h).

maya: Follow-ups: 1) run secrets sidecar e2e in staging (assigned to chris); 2) schedule HSM import if customer requires (assigned to ops-oncall); 3) confirm audit export to SIEM (assigned to leah).

chris: Will do sidecar e2e today.

leah: I'll validate SIEM export and rotation policy.

maya: Closing loop here — ready to provision once the above tasks are done. :rocket:
